findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the homepage link's accessible name is 'Design System', while the visible label reads 'GOV•UK Design System' (the GOV.UK wordmark is an SVG excluded from the name). A speech user saying 'click GOV.UK Design System' may not match.
findings.after: Give the SVG <title>GOV.UK</title> and role="img" (or aria-label="GOV.UK Design System" on the link)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.5.3 Label in Name: the accessible name should contain the visible label text.

findings.evidence: The search combobox has an accessible name ('Search Design system') but its only visible label is the placeholder 'Search Design System' plus a magnifier icon (tile 1440-00).
findings.after: Acceptable for a site search per common practice; optionally a visually persistent label or keep the icon + text that does not vanish on input
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions: placeholder text disappears on typing.

strengths: Skip link is the first real focusable ('Skip to main content'); the sweep's 'first focusable is Accept analytics cookies' comes from the cookie banner that capture prep then dismissed.
Focus states use the GOV.UK yellow #ffdd00 3px ring with black underline; one h1, sequential h2/h3; header, nav, main, footer landmarks; lang=en.
Body links are underlined and distinguishable without colour; link text is descriptive ('Read the release notes for v6.6.0 on GitHub', 'Browse our components').
Decorative homepage illustration has alt=""; 375 view collapses nav into a 'Menu' disclosure with no horizontal scroll.
not_investigated: disputed: sweep A11-003 'Get started focus indicator faint 2.92:1' — the GOV.UK focus style on the inverse (white) button on blue is a yellow fill with black underline, which reads clearly; 2.4.13 is AAA and the measured value is just under 3:1.
keyboard operation of the 'Menu' toggle and search autocomplete: no live test
